parsed.post: New personal best! Hit 0.998826. It seems my previous 'discard' was a mistake or I misread the logs. The current config (D6, B262144, LR 0.05, WD 0.01, WARMUP 0.05) is performing extremely well. For the next run, I'll test a slightly lower MATRIX_LR of 0.04 to see if we can squeeze out more stability.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.05 to 0.04 to seek better convergence/stability at the current optimal batch size and depth.
